name: Andrea Elson
bio: Andrea Elson is a well-known former actress estaodounidense, famous for her role in the sitcom "ALF" from 1986. Andrea Elson was born in 1969, in the city of New York, United States. Lived all her childhood in New York, raised by parents who willingly signed up at a theatre school when she told them that she wanted to be an actress. Little after completing her primary studies began attending castings of characters getting an appearance in the 1983 series "Whiz Kids". After that made countless appearances in various series such as "Simon & Simon" in 1983, "Silver Spoons" in 1985 and which came after ALF. In September 1986 premiered the sitcom "ALF" where a charismatic alien joined an American family, creating countless funny situations.
